root_cause: The struct fields for the newly-allocated side-data object are initialized AFTER handing the wrapping buffer off to a function (ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext) that can take ownership of / free that buffer, instead of before. This creates a window in which the memory the code is about to write to is no longer guaranteed to be valid/owned by this code path.
findings: In h2645_sei_to_side_data(), when handling the Ambient Viewing Environment SEI, a new AVAmbientViewingEnvironment struct (dst_env) is allocated and wrapped in an AVBufferRef (buf), which is then handed off to ff_frame_new_side_data_from_buf_ext().
